brief:
UN Special Rapporteur Francesca Albanese said Israel bears responsibility for settler violence in the West Bank, contending the state is "outsourcing coercion" to settlers, Al Jazeera English reported. Albanese did not detail specific incidents but characterized the pattern as integral to Israel's control apparatus in occupied Palestinian territories.

The assertion intensifies international pressure on settler attacks against Palestinians and their property in the West Bank. Albanese's comments reflect deepening concern among UN officials over the nexus between Israeli state actions and violence by settlers operating in the occupied territories.

The rapporteur's office monitors human rights violations and alleged abuses in Palestinian areas under Israeli administration. Her statement comes amid repeated clashes between Palestinian residents and Israeli settlers, particularly in flashpoint communities throughout the West Bank.
dek: UN Special Rapporteur Francesca Albanese says Israel bears responsibility and is outsourcing coercion to settlers.
title: UN envoy accuses Israel of outsourcing coercion to West Bank settlers
